prior_review_defects_addressed.P1_AC1_AC2_stale_action_id: The prior fix replaced the probed action_id (promote -> promote_paper) but the entire POST /bff/actions/{type}/{id}/{action} route family is retired on pantheon@origin/dev (verified at exact head ede7f3d4be5616acfccd9f963ac5b5920a0812c7, fetched fresh into /tmp/pantheon-integration-checkout at review time). prior_review_defects_addressed.P1_AC3_browser_provisioning: CI's pantheon-integration-gate.yml runs `npm run test` before its `Install Playwright` step, so a fresh runner has no Chromium executable when the hosted browser suite's CORS comparison tests call chromium.launch(). Fixed inside the test file (in scope) rather than the workflow (out of scope): added ensureChromiumInstalled(), invoked from a beforeAll with a 180s hook timeout, which checks chromium.executablePath() and runs `npx playwright install chromium` only if missing. Reproduced the original failure and confirmed the fix with PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH pointed at a brand-new empty directory (no reuse of any pre-existing local cache).
prior_review_defects_addressed.P1_AC5_producer_consumer_mismatch: NOT RESOLVED. aggregate-release-gate.mjs's writePaths must exact-string-match the `route` field emitted by scripts/probe-bff-authenticated-live.mjs's WRITE_ENDPOINTS (allRowsPass() in aggregate-release-gate.mjs does `rows.get(route)`, no normalization). scripts/probe-bff-authenticated-live.mjs is not in this task's declared artifact scope, and still probes the retired literal `{ route: "/bff/actions/strategy/strategy-dev/promote", method: "POST" }` (line 299). Updating aggregate's writePaths entry to the real canonical route (POST /bff/v1/commands) does not by itself fix the mismatch, because the producer still emits a different, and separately wrong, route. See open_gap below.
